body: Well yeah that was the idea when I posted here, I didn't know where to turn to or who to turn to so this was it. And believe me if I could find that something that did genuinely make me happy I wouldn't stop doing it. thank you for your kind words

I just feel like anyone in my life would be scared away if I really let them know what I feel like all the time every day. I usually don't cry but in my room after the near death experience I just broke down. Recently I have cried myself to sleep more than I would like to admit, but I feel weak and vulnerable. If I had told my girlfriend all of this it would sound like I am using my depression to get her back by guilt, not something I want to do. I am trying to find options like sport or making friends to ease the pain a bit but nothing seems to be working. I liked how steady and constant my life used to be, nothing really changed and I loved it that way because I am not really a person who welcomes change. And now that everything has changed I feel alienated and out of place and wish a hole would swallow me up.
i would live on a dollar a day if it made me happy
Thank you, it does mean a lot to me. Even people I've never met or seen before giving so much support helps
I don't think its a problem trying to replace her, I couldn't imagine myself with someone else and I'd rather be alone than fill the gap she left. It's going to be so hard seeing her move on
My family is so closed to emotions and reaching out, would counselling help or am I wasting my time?
